items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: He had the group, it was called the Tennessee 10s and I got acquainted with these two Johnson boys, as I said one was a guitar player and the other was a bass player. So we would close the show on the off him, that's how we come out here.

ctx.x: Oh, another thing we didn't cover was the Tennessee 10, if Mr. Wright can help you out a little bit. Yes, he can because he can call Slow Kid's name and I can't call it.
Well, Slow Kid had the band, see? He was in charge and through these-
U.S. Thompson. Yeah, Thompson. U.S. Nicknamed Slow Kid Thompson.
